newsitem.title: FINLAND: SILJA SEES H2 PROFIT, FULL-YR 1997 LOSS.
newsitem.headline: SILJA SEES H2 PROFIT, FULL-YR 1997 LOSS.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Oy Silja Ab said on Friday it expected second-half earnings to show a clear profit, but the grop's full-year 1997 result would still show a small loss.
"The Group result for the second half of the year will show a clear profit. However, the full-year result is estimated to show a minor loss," Silja said in a statement with its January-June resluts.
In H1, Silja's loss after financial items deepened to 144 million markka from 127 million in the year-ago period.
